## 简体中文

### 新增

- 新增首次运行引导，可独立选择启用任务栏和 AllTab；两个功能在用户选择前默认保持关闭。
- 新增隐藏没有打开窗口的运行中应用的任务栏设置。
- 新增开始菜单搜索结果的键盘选择与确认操作。

### 性能

- 快速按下并松开 Alt-Tab 时会在切换界面出现前直接完成窗口切换；较长的切换会话继续使用缓存缩略图和后台刷新来保持响应速度。
- Alt-Tab 背景改用系统合成器的实时毛玻璃材质，不再截取并模糊屏幕快照。

### 修复

- 修复重复打开 Alt-Tab 时背景逐次模糊直至接近纯色的问题，并让实时材质、窗口卡片、标题、控件、边框和占位背景适配浅色与深色外观。
- 按视觉宽度平衡 Alt-Tab 各行，让较少的窗口贴合内容，并确保密集布局保持在扣除任务栏后的可用区域内。
- 可靠跟踪物理修饰键释放，并在主线程激活 WinTaskbar 自身窗口。
- 预留任务栏空间时忽略过期的 Dock 工作区状态。

## English

### Added

- Added first-run onboarding with independent Taskbar and AllTab choices, leaving both features disabled until selected.
- Added a taskbar setting that hides running applications without open windows.
- Added keyboard selection and confirmation while searching the Start menu.

### Performance

- Quick Alt-Tab presses now switch windows before the overlay appears, while longer sessions remain responsive with cached thumbnails and background refreshes.
- The Alt-Tab backdrop now uses the system compositor's live material instead of captured and blurred screen snapshots.

### Fixed

- Prevented repeated Alt-Tab presentations from progressively blurring their own backdrop, and adapted the live material, window cards, titles, controls, borders, and placeholders to Light and Dark appearances.
- Balanced Alt-Tab rows by visual width, fitted smaller window sets to their content, and kept dense layouts within the available taskbar work area.
- Reliably tracked physical modifier release and activated WinTaskbar-owned windows on the main thread.
- Ignored stale Dock work-area state when reserving taskbar space.
